claim: Factory buildings separate clearly from the deck and raster destination icons read as one cohesive industrial mobile HUD.
artifact_or_command: Independent comparison of final 844x390 and 568x320 factory captures against d46bfdb

assertions: command label no longer covers the toilet building
critical HUD and icons remain inside bounds

grader.name: independent factory depth and icon critic

observation: Independent critic returned PASS with 8.6 overall, 8.4 lowest viewport, 8.1 lowest dimension and 0.96 confidence.
inference: The second pass resolves the compact HUD and landmark-obstruction regressions while retaining the accepted world-first factory direction.
limitations: Compact production-rate text remains small; background towers touch the top edge; right detailed color icons and bottom monochrome icons are not fully unified; peripheral platform materials remain somewhat uniform.
